name: Collision Auto Glass & Calibration
address: 14201 NW Science Park Dr, Portland, OR 97229, USA

quotes.text: I was quoted a 3-5 hour wait time to get my Jeep Grand Cherokee windshield replaced...they were done in 2.5 hours, complete with all the sensor calibrations. Their technician nicked the dash leaving a very small and almost unnoticeable cut. They were prompt to inform me and offered to send it in to get the dash repaired, or just accept it and knocked off some $$. I truly appreciated their immediate response and acceptance of responsibility. As it was extremely small, I just accepted the reduced price and can easily fix such a tiny cut with the Permatex vinyl & leather repair kit without it being easily noticed...if at all.
quotes.author: Robert

quotes.text:
From the moment I called, I was treated with kindness and professionalism. Everyone—from the staff who answered the phone to the technicians who completed the work—made the entire experience easy and stress-free. The lobby was exceptionally comfortable, and I truly felt like I was treated as family, not just another customer.

The level of care, attention to detail, and customer service was outstanding. I highly recommend Collision Auto Glass & Calibration to anyone looking for honest, friendly, and top-quality service. Thank you for making such a great experience!
quotes.author: lisa chapman

quotes.text:
Great experience at Collision Auto Glass & Calibration. I was referred by Land Rover Portland.
From the moment I called, Brad was very helpful and easy to work with. He walked me through the insurance claim and explained the process from start to finish. It took a few days for the insurance to process, but once they had my vehicle, the turnaround was quick—about 4 hours.
Professional, flexible, and they even have a really sweet dog greeting customers. Highly recommend for window replacement!
quotes.author: M Cuter
